notes: Preparing purchase orders (ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP + ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET): same tables as generated, legacy column order and display items; line rules (item, price and MOH discount, bonus / discount pairs, chosen lines need quantity and price), buttons load items / choose all / exclude all / delete zero lines / load Excel / make purchase order (APP_RULES3_PR). Wave 3b: CHK check box, legacy header LOVs, line statistics as computed columns (net sales / purchases of the period, store balances, last purchase date, open / closed orders).

row_rules.ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET:
-- legacy line WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM / PRE-INSERT: item, group, supplier and manufacturer of the item, retail price and MOH discount,
-- ratios 0..100, values >= 0, bonus / extra bonus / discounts, chosen lines need quantity + bonus > 0 and a price
app_rules3_pr.prep_det_row(inserting, :new.serial, :new.item_group_code, :new.item_code, :new.supp_code, :new.kind_code,
  :new.quantity, :old.quantity, :new.chk, :new.unit_price, :old.unit_price,
  :new.percentage, :old.percentage, :new.bonus, :old.bonus, :new.extra_percentage, :old.extra_percentage, :new.extra_bonus, :old.extra_bonus,
  :new.disc1_ratio, :old.disc1_ratio, :new.disc1_value, :old.disc1_value, :new.disc2_ratio, :old.disc2_ratio, :new.disc2_value, :old.disc2_value,
  :new.m_disc_ratio, :new.m_disc_value, :new.po_m_disc_ratio, :new.po_m_disc_value);

validations.name: تحضير أمر الشراء: التواريخ والمورد والمستودع ونوع الأمر

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.SUPP_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where supplier_status = 1 order by code

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.PO_SUPP.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where supplier_status = 1 order by code

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.PO_STORE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || name_a d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 and nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 order by store_code

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.PR_ORDER_TYPE.lov: select serial || ' - ' || nvl(name_a, name_e) d, serial r from st_pr_order_types order by 2

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.FROM_KIND.lov: select kind_code || ' - ' || nvl(name_a, name_e) d, kind_code r from st_good_kind where kind_code in (select kind_code from vn_supp_kind where supp_code = :PAGE_SUPP_CODE) or :PAGE_SUPP_CODE is null order by 2

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.FROM_CLASS.lov: select class_code || ' - ' || nvl(desc_a, desc_e) d, class_code r from st_item_classes order by 2

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP.CNTRCT_SERIAL.lov: select a.serial || ' - ' || k.name_a || ' / ' || c.name_a || ' - ' || to_char(a.end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, a.serial r from st_supp_agrmnt a, supplier s, st_supp_agrmnt_supp p, st_good_kind k, st_cntrct_types c where p.supplier_code = s.code and a.serial = p.serial and a.kind_code = k.kind_code and c.cntrct_code = a.cntrct_code and s.code = :PAGE_PO_SUPP and nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 order by 2

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.NET_SALES.sql: (select nvl(sum(case when c.trns_date between h.from_date and h.to_date then 1 else 0 end * decode(nvl(y.opening_balance, 0), 1, 0, 1) * decode(y.effect || y.trns_type, '22', 1, '44', -1, 0) * c.basic_qty), 0) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y, st_po_item_supp h where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code and h.serial = t.serial)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.NET_PURCH.sql: (select nvl(sum(case when c.trns_date between h.from_date and h.to_date then 1 else 0 end * decode(nvl(y.opening_balance, 0), 1, 0, 1) * decode(y.effect || y.trns_type, '11', 1, '33', -1, 0) * c.basic_qty), 0) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y, st_po_item_supp h where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code and h.serial = t.serial)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.GNRL_BAL.sql: (select nvl(sum(decode(c.store_code, (select max(gnrlz_store) from st_basic), 1, 0) * decode(y.effect, 1, 1, 2, -1, 3, -1, 4, 1, 5, -1, 6, 1) * nvl(c.basic_qty, 0)), 0) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.DMG_BAL.sql: (select nvl(sum(decode(c.store_code, (select max(dmg_store) from st_basic), 1, 0) * decode(y.effect, 1, 1, 2, -1, 3, -1, 4, 1, 5, -1, 6, 1) * nvl(c.basic_qty, 0)), 0) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.DISTRB_BAL.sql: (select nvl(sum(decode(c.store_code, (select max(distrb_store) from st_basic), 1, 0) * decode(y.effect, 1, 1, 2, -1, 3, -1, 4, 1, 5, -1, 6, 1) * nvl(c.basic_qty, 0)), 0) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.TOT_BAL.sql: (select nvl(sum(decode(y.effect, 1, 1, 2, -1, 3, -1, 4, 1, 5, -1, 6, 1) * nvl(c.basic_qty, 0)), 0) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.LAST_PURCH_DATE.sql: (select max(decode(y.effect || y.trns_type || nvl(y.opening_balance, 0), '110', c.trns_date)) from st_trns_det_cost c, st_trns_type y where y.trns_type_code = c.trns_type_code and nvl(c.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and c.group_code = t.item_group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.SUM_PR_OPEN.sql: (select nvl(sum(decode(nvl(m.order_status, 0), 0, 1, 0)), 0) from pr_order m, pr_order_det o where nvl(m.confirm_flag, 0) = 1 and m.trns_type_code = o.trns_type_code and m.trns_serial = o.trns_serial and o.item_code = t.item_code and o.group_code = t.item_group_code and nvl(m.close_flag, 0) = 0)

ST_PO_ITEM_SUPP_DET.SUM_PR_CLOSE.sql: (select nvl(sum(decode(nvl(m.order_status, 0), 0, 0, 1)), 0) from pr_order m, pr_order_det o where nvl(m.confirm_flag, 0) = 1 and m.trns_type_code = o.trns_type_code and m.trns_serial = o.trns_serial and o.item_code = t.item_code and o.group_code = t.item_group_code and nvl(m.close_flag, 0) = 0)

params.name: ORDER_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 7 and t.trns_type = 14 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by 2
